Fixed in 1a4fdd5e8 and 8eb99062b. When the lookup fails, the kept paste stays invalid until the user edits it. The marker now lives on the input, like `unreadText`, so a page restored from Turbo's cache keeps it too. After a failed lookup, a new paste is read straight away instead of being kept for a lookup that will not land. A new system test rejects the lookup and checks that the field stays invalid until it is edited.

Fixed in 8eb99062b. `money_field` now takes `min_precision`, a number of decimals kept on top of whichever currency the field follows. The Monarch balance passes the saved balance's decimals there instead of a fixed precision. A JPY target with 123.4 keeps its one decimal, a switch to USD takes cents, and a whole 1500 on a JPY target stays whole yen. Controller tests cover both cases.
